rationale: The benchmark candidate is structured_delivery because the change introduces product semantics across three canonical owners and multiple source and derived paths. Compact paths fail closed: verified_change requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation, while compact_delivery additionally requires a completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context, neither of which is supplied. This is a non-authorizing classification only.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Product semantics impact is explicitly true.
No completed Brownfield analysis is supplied.
No stored quick_task context is supplied, so compact_delivery requirements are unmet.
Any impact beyond the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
